The '''Vizcarra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vizcarra]].
